verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own AI agents (Fieldwork), so a buyer could fairly ask whether those agents can consume external MCP servers; the axis applies. Every MCP item in the pack describes the opposite direction: external assistants connecting to Oneleet's own MCP server via OAuth or service keys. That is server-side capability and cannot be credited here, and nothing shows Oneleet plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
